training.model: linear conditional means and centered treatment contrasts for two measured outcomes
training.regularization: ridge 1 for player-state means, 8 for state × held and state × centered stock; doubled ridge for treatment contrasts
training.hyperparameter_selection: fixed before training, no held-out selection
training.enrollment: randomized actions conditional on enrolled, positive-stock, available intervention windows. Rare and common enrollment probabilities differ.
training.offpolicy: IPS and cross-fitted doubly robust values per enrolled window; each observed action has propensity 0.5. No inverse enrollment weighting.
training.runtime_limits: Inference scores every action including unsupported stock/held states; later stages and repeated policy decisions were not randomized by the study. Collector forced release on follow-up decisions.

experiment.bomb_counting: Native adapter inventory decreases on steps without a life loss.
